translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Kabilia oluwalaisi Saulo la boda deli Debida la boda ikau tuta saina kaduwonaku. Avai tuta Debida ivigaki ipeuligaga okabilia e tuta matutona kala tilaula imamasi.
Debida litula tauwau
E livalesi tailima taitala matausina Debida litula, matausina Debida leiuni mapilana Ebironi. kuluta Aminoni matauna inala Ainowam vilela Yesireeli;
Kiliabi matauna inala Abigeili Nabali kubuyala vilela Kamela; Abisalom matauna inala Maaka minana guyau Talimai latula viluwela Gesura;
Adonia matauna inala Agita, Sepatia matauna inala Abitali;
Itireyam matauna inala Egila. Komwaidosi matausina litula Debida tauwau ikaloubusisi ovalu Ebironi.
Abina itokaila Debida
E kabilia isisaitaula wala oluwalaisi Debida la tokabilia deli Saulo la tokabilia komwaidona. E Abina ipeuluvagasi oluwalaisi Saulo la boda.
E kwaitala yam Isiboseti matauna Saulo latula itabinaki Abina mwada imisii Risipa Saulo la ula eivigaki makawala la kwava, minana Aiya latula.

Abina igidaleiya sainela eikaibiga kawala, “Ki m nanamsa kudoki yeigu ibodi bakasali Saulo ke? Ki kaina kudoki nanom yeigu lawotitali Yuda ke? Omitibogwa leima lagaila yeigu akamiabi tamam Saulo, budala deli lubaila, e yeigu bogwa lakolaim metoya Debida ola peula; mitaga lagaila yoku lokunevi ulo sula paila natana vivila!

E Guyau bogwa ikatotila baisa Debida paila bikau kabokaraiwaga metoya baisa Saulo deli dalela e bivigaki Debida biguyoi Isireli deli Yuda, metoya kabulotala valu bila kabuluyuwela okala vigimkoila. Ka, baisa tuta ibodi Guyau bikatumataigu kidamwa gala bavigaki vavagi makwaina bikamokwita!”
Isiboseti saina ikukoli Abina e gala ibodi bilivala avai biga tuvaila.

Abina iwitali touwata baisa Debida, tuta matutona matauna eisisu Ebironi, bilukwaisi kawasi, “Availaga bikaraiwogi valu mapilana? Ibodi bitaninatala e yeigu bapilasaim bukuvatati komwaidona Isireli bitokailamsi.”

E Debida imapu kawala, “Saina bwaina! Bogwa baninatala baisa yoku kidamwa goli bukuvagi kwaitala vavagi, kwaitinidesi wala. Ka, avai tuta bukuma bukubodaigu, kuvakouli Mikali minana Saulo latula e kumiakaigu.”
E Debida tuvaila iwitali biga baisa Isiboseti bilukwaisi kawasi, “Kwaimilivau ulo kwava Mikali kusakaigu. Lamipuki minana metoya lakatutala mina Pilisitia uwosi paila bavaiya minana.”
Mapaila Isiboseti ivakouli minana metoya baisa la mwala Palitieli matauna Laisi latula.
E Palitieli deli wala vilamla ibubokuli minawena tatoula ikaloubusisi ovalu Baurim. Mitaga avai tuta Abina iluki matauna kawala, “Kukwaimilavau om valu,” matauna ikaimilavau wala.
E Abina ilokaia tokugwala Isireli e iluki matausina kawala, “Omitibogwa leima lagaila yokomi magimi Debida biguyau.

E ka, baisa tuta mi tuta. Kululuwaisi avaka Guyau bogwa eilivala kawala, ‘Yeigu bavigaki ulo touwata Debida bikoli ulo tomota mina Isireli metoya mina Pilisitia deli goli metoya komwaidona kasi tilaula.’”
Abina tuvaila ibigatona baisa Beniamina dalela e oluvi ila Ebironi biluki Debida avaka tomotala Beniamina deli tomotala Isireli leikabwailisi bivagaisi.
Avai tuta Abina deli la tokabilia tailuwoyu imakaiasi Debida mapilana Ebironi, Debida ivagi kwaitala paka paila matausina.

E Abina iluki Debida kawala, “Mwa, ulo guyau! Baisa tuta wala balokaia mina Isireli e bavatati matausina paila yoku. Matausina bikabwalimsi bukuguyau, e oluvi bukubani makwaina vavagi avaka magim, e bukuguyoi pilamwaidona valu.” Debida ibigibwaili Abina e iwitali matauna ila.
Ikatumataisi Abina

E oluvi Debida la kumatoula deli Yowabi ikaimilavausi metoya valu mavilouna leiyoulisi, imaiyaisi guguwa saina bidugaga leilebwaisi. Mitaga Abina gala isisu ovalu Ebironi sola Debida paila Debida bogwa ikabwaili matauna e iwitali ila.
E avai tuta Yowabi deli la tokabilia bogwa eiviloubusisi eilukwaisi Abina bogwa leimakaia guyau Debida e ikabwaili matauna iwitali ila.
Mapaila Yowabi ilokaia guyau e iluki matauna kawala, “Ki avai nagowala kuuvagi makawala ke? Abina leimakaiam - avaka uula lokuluki matauna leila ke?
Ka matauna leima baisa bisinapwaim paila binikoli vavagi komwaidona avaka lokuuvagi deli ambaisa ambaisa bukulokaia. Baisa bogwa lokunikoli kadai!”
Avai tuta Yowabi isilavi Debida, iwitali touwata ilokaiasi Abina, e imaiyaisi matauna metoya wa sopi Sira, mitaga Debida gala wala inikoli vavagi makwaina.

Avai tuta Abina iviloubusi mapilana Ebironi, Yowabi ivakouli matauna ilau opapala kalapisila, mwada kala gigisa magila kasitaiyu wala bibigatonasi, e tuta matutona wala ibasi matauna olopola ikaliga. Mapaila Abina ikatumataisi paila uula eikatumati Yowabi bodala Asaeli.
Avai tuta Debida inakaigali bulogala, ikaibiga kawala, “Guyau inikoli yeigu deli ulo kabokaraiwaga komwaidona tobubwaila wala paila Abina la kaliga.

Ibodi mipuki makwaina bibanaisi Yowabi deli dalela! Wa tubwa komwaidona ibodi taitala tomota odalela biyosi kwesimwauru kaina kagwaiguya kaina bivagi tobutuvivila bibwainaki vivila wala si paisewa, kaina bikatumataisi okabilia kaina bigigadi wala molu!”
Mapaila Yowabi sola bodala Abisai ikauwaisi lugwa baisa Abina paila leikatumati budasi Asaeli okawakali mapilana Gibioni.
Abina ibakwaisi

Oluvi Debida ikaraiwogi Yowabi deli la tokabilia bikisaisi kasi kwama, e bisikamsi si saigala deli bivalamsi paila Abina. E otutala kalisamila tomata ikugwaiyaisi Guyau Debida kalamwateta ililoula oluvi.
Abina leibakwaisi mapilana Ebironi, e guyau ikavinavina deli kaigaveka kaigala wa laka, e makawala goli tomota komwaidona.
Mapilana Debida la kaivalam paila Abina.

content.text: “Avaka paila Abina la kaliga makawala taitala tonagowa?
La kaliga makawala wala taitala tau tolibulebu leiwaiyasi!”

content: Mapaila tomota tuvaila wala ikatumwali iuvalamsi.
E yam kwemwaidona makwaina tomota ivigikonaisi ammakawala Debida sitana bikam, mitaga ikatotila saina peula kawala, “Kidamwa bakoma avaka oluviga kalasia bisalili ibodi Yaubada bikatumataigu!”
Matausina ikabwailisi, e saina iyomwasali ninasi. E komwaidona goli avaka guyau eiuvagi iyomwasali wala tomota.
Komwaidona Debida la tomota deli komwaidona tomotala Isireli bogwa einikolaisi si guyau gala deli kala kakalawa paila Abina kala katumata.
E guyau iluki la tosikwawa kawala, “Ki gala kaina kululuwaisi paila yam lagaila taitala tokugwa toveka olopola Isireli eikaliga!

Ilagoli yeigu guyau Yaubada einagaigu, mitaga agu lumkola mama sainela yam lagaila. Matausina litula Seruya saina iyotigininaigusi. Ibodi Guyau bimipuki matausina tokatumata makawala einainevisi e ibanaisi kaliga.”
